blocks.source:
`mdbook build docs/book --dest-dir DEST` resolves relative `DEST` against the
invocation working directory, not `docs/book`. Therefore `../../.artifacts/`
from the repository root escapes the repository. The reset-slice publisher
exposed that mistaken assumption when it could not find fresh local HTML.

Custom-output automation must derive an absolute destination from the current
repository root at runtime, check it remains inside the root and on its volume,
and start with a fresh destination. Persist its repository-relative identity;
never change the actual tool argument merely to avoid recording an absolute
path. Build success alone does not identify the output consumed by validation.

The owning reset slice copied and hash-verified both exact misplaced books,
consumed their recovered HTML, deleted only those old roots, and recorded the
residue census. The first carrier build had been valid and local; the later
relative-destination check reused that earlier render. Its historical receipt
now explicitly records the correction. No compiler or HDL test result changes.
The tracked probe builds a miniature book from another source directory,
checks relative and absolute destinations against the invocation directory,
requires fresh marker-bearing HTML and same-volume local paths, then removes
its owned temporary workspace. The manifest retains the actual recovery.
## Native canonical source views

The selected source-view plane uses relative filesystem links to canonical
repository files and native-safe `.source.txt` addresses. A terminal `.md` in
the address is encoded as `.markdown`: the initial `.md.source.txt` recipe
served a directly requested asset but native rendered clicks were rewritten
to `.html`. Actual href checks qualify the encoded recipe. Views preserve
complete UTF8 source text; Markdown links inside them remain literal text.

The admitted mdBook0.5.4 prototype serves every selected source and refreshes
a controlled visible source outside the book directory under default native
serve. Ignored scratch and deliberately parent-ignored visible inputs remain
stale, including with extra-watch enabled. Source presence and successful
build do not prove watcher admission. The executed factory checks complete
selection, current source endpoints/bytes and ignore policy; native output
verification additionally checks every copied source. Published views reflect
their latest book build, without a universal refresh-time or platform promise.

`python3 -B scripts/book_source_references.py --write` regenerates the finite
manifest and relative endpoints. `--check` qualifies current sources;
`--verify-build .artifacts/BOOK_OUTPUT` also checks copied native bytes. The
original destination-locality replay remains required, alongside the recorded
source-plane qualifier. Source and asset paths must remain on the repository
volume and within this repository. No extra chapter or copied prose is added.
## Historical and current reader roles

An actual source-qualified helper-card extension obstructed the original
source-plane default replay because it invoked the old whole-current helper
reader. The qualified historical adapter changes only that call to the helper
reader's existing snapshot mode, conserving every other original predicate,
programme and product. Its command is:
`python3 -B docs/audits/record-value-helper-reader-role-adapter-20261005/adapter.py --snapshot`

Historical success does not establish current card, query, reader or source
currency. The current publication reader checks complete core/helper/tooling
meanings and question ownership, unique book guidance, canonical source-view
selection/endpoints/bytes/ignore policy, exact current budget and indexed members.
The original destination-locality replay remains required. Native copied bytes
still need the factory's explicit output check; visual QA remains pending.

blocks.source:
Separate models qualify whole typed graph bijections, reachable reference counts,
input/result sharing, readonly, kinds, cycles and detachment for the plain profile.
Genuine Storable/alias/split-sharing/cycle-alias/input-kind/result-kind providers
reach intended assertions; non-target records conserve.

Native refusal records preserve whole causes, class, HASH shape and within-capture
identity for both observed empty blessed classes. Native-class copying and
structured-clone cycle support remain unqualified. Graph/cause/identity and whole
programme mutations reject.

Fresh same-volume replay uses pinned sources and retains all native records
and both streams. Addresses have per-capture lifetimes; sealed producers run
elsewhere. The finite join authenticates completed owners and fresh products.
Original captures retain unchanged-input Storable/alias trials and the full
alias run’s downstream mutation/abort. Independent typed models qualify
original copy graphs, genuine trials, readonly and detachment. Whole API/parser
results match source models; private-source allocations conserve. Independently
modeled copy interventions rebuild full input/private typed graphs, readonly
copies and detached outputs. The known private range sibling changes string
width2 to number2; its outer caller stays unchanged through a detached private copy.
Every copied width joins the full raw type, carrier/default/metadata roles,
ancestor context and compatible-source set. The input/private join qualifies
whole graph/field/source/context/raw-kind/detachment meanings for the captured
modes. Finite source-context models qualify helper/consumer/parser locations,
complete parser texts and operation spans, separately from cause/operand truth.
Independent primary models derive each API/helper/parser first cause and
acceptance from qualified source inputs.
Raw bodies and lossless grammar qualify. Source/publisher contracts infer
unblessed scalar errors for this finite capture; original classes were unmeasured.
POD4.05 is stale; runtime JSON::PP4.06 owns version identity. Direct Value models
bind active order and source roles to visible type/scalar footprints. Metadata
guard/record-recursion paths qualify, including cycles; list recursion is bound
but unexercised. Nested Scope/capture/private-root inputs bind the entire
source-constructed interface graph, preserving kinds, sharing and cycles.
Whole inner scalar forwarding now conserves the new outer prefix. Public die
controls distinguish explicit rethrow, propagation and hook replacement. Original
hook state/provider bytes stay unmeasured. Source models join nested Value and
capture/Scope eval/wrapper paths and visible operand roles. The complete own API
join partitions every refusal into source guard/function/visible-role models. Own observer and helper source meanings are canonical in the
[observer/helper path card](record-value-original-observer-helper-paths.md).
Full observer/display/frame/coordinate/address, consumer, alias/semantic/cold/
candidate-parent, hot and host-native meanings remain open.
Reverify runs the complete source chain and separate probe replay.

blocks.source:
Own observer/callback source roles/bodies/allocations inventory.
Observer models join every API/parser operation, eval and installed wrapper with
source argument roles. The parser receiver role is declared; identity is unmeasured.
Named helpers preserve complete source graphs and active paths.
Compiled callback/refuses/helper-wrapper paths bind parameterless operation,
source regex-body and label displays; identity and full formatting remain open.
Source join binds every helper allocation, full supplied/default
inputs, returned argument-building operations and compiled callback/refusal paths
through both nested throw phases. Source models construct the intended join
before comparing recorded contiguous function order and visible argument roles.
Returned helpers are separate from active frames. Complete model/allocation/
phase/member/order/operand corruptions reject.

Full observer/display/frame/class-frame/raw-coordinate/address, subtest/load,
framework/quoting/truncation and parser-internal meanings stay open.
Original provider/hook/class measurements and callback/regex/object/native
identity stay unmeasured. Consumer, alias, complete semantic/cold/
candidate-parent and permanent/hot/host-native repairs stay open; visual
mdBook QA is pending.
Related: [[record-value-finite-copy-probe-reader]].
## Qualified own subtest and do-load source boundaries

The complete own source model assigns every original refusal to its authored
named subtest body. The observer saves the public Test::More subtest delegate,
receives the name/body/extra arguments, wraps the callback with the
compiled-helper observer, forwards the callback arguments to the original body
and forwards extra arguments to the saved delegate. Authored original subtests
supply no extra arguments. Recorded throw-phase headers agree with the modeled
body and own observer callback's empty visible argument lists and with the
public delegate/own entry's authored name and CODE reference kind. The reference
kind does not establish actual callback identity. External framework frames
between those own roles are retained as opaque observations.

The observer's original test load is an explicit do
'./t/1986-isf-record-port-value-gates.t', followed by captures of $@, $! and
defined($ok). Recorded diagnostic frames contain a require marker with that
exact file identifier. This marker agrees with the file role; it does not change
the source operator to require or establish the formatter. Necessary installed
public POD documents named subtest callbacks and extra arguments, do-file
return/error semantics and require's do-file loading mechanism. The captured
current Perl/Test::More profile is current public-interface evidence; the
original framework version remains unmeasured.

Original Test::Builder/Test::More headers match authored-name prefixes/CODE
kinds and body/delegate/entry/do-load order at every throw phase. Independent
dated public fixtures select them. Receiver tokens/private eval intervals stay
opaque. Wrong name/kind/population/order rejects.
